question: Where did Siddhartha Gautam meditate for many days?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bodh Gaya**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Bodh Gaya** is the sacred site where **Siddhartha Gautama**, later known as **Lord Buddha**, attained enlightenment under the **Bodhi Tree**. 
• This location is situated in the state of **Bihar, India**, and is considered one of the most important pilgrimage sites for Buddhists worldwide. 
• Siddhartha Gautama meditated here for several days, during which he overcame temptations and distractions and achieved enlightenment, becoming the **Buddha**. 
• The **Mahabodhi Temple Complex** at Bodh Gaya is now a UNESCO **World Heritage Site**, commemorating this significant event in Buddhist history. 
• The Bodhi Tree, under which Buddha meditated, is a direct descendent of the original tree and is revered by millions of followers. 
• **Hence, the correct answer is Bodh Gaya.**<
